selected_23_model: Let F2^6=A direct_sum B with dim A=dim B=3 and choose bases EA,EB. The selected 23 projective points are (A\{0}) union (B\{0}) union {e+f:e in EA,f in EB} = 7+7+9.
complement_40_model: {(u,v):u in A\{0}, v in B\{0}} minus (EA x EB), hence 7*7-3*3=40.
full_GL6_2_setwise_stabilizer: S3 wr C2 = (S3 x S3) semidirect C2
proof: The only projective planes PG(2,2) wholly contained in the selected 23-set are A\{0} and B\{0}. To prove this, suppose a 3-space H is mixed. Every mixed nonzero vector in H must be a grid vector (e_i,f_j). If two grid vectors differ in both row and column, their sum has both components of coordinate weight two and is outside the selected set. Hence all mixed vectors of H lie in one grid row or one grid column. Three mixed vectors in one row (e_i,f_1),(e_i,f_2),(e_i,f_3) have sum (e_i,f_1+f_2+f_3), which is not selected; so H has at most two mixed nonzero vectors. But if r_A=dim(H intersect A), r_B=dim(H intersect B), then r_A+r_B<=3 and, for a genuinely mixed H, the number of pure nonzero vectors is at most (2^2-1)+(2^1-1)=4. Thus a 3-space with seven nonzero vectors has at least three mixed vectors, contradiction. Therefore H is A or B.

Since A and B are the unique full Fano planes in the 23-set, every linear setwise stabilizer preserves or swaps the unordered pair {A,B}. Within A, a point u has some f in B with u+f among the 9 cross-grid points iff u is one of the three chosen basis points EA; similarly for B. Hence a stabilizer preserving A and B must preserve EA and EB setwise, giving S3 x S3. The block swap A<->B is present, so the full stabilizer is S3 wr C2 of order 72.

Under S3 on a Fano plane with a chosen basis, the seven nonzero points have three orbits by coordinate weight: sizes 3,3,1. On the complement, unordered type pairs excluding (1,1) have sizes 18,6,9,6,1.
W33_point_action_comparison: The certified Pass1021 E8-root base/W33 point action is transitive of rank 3 with subdegrees 1,12,27 and PSp(4,3) order 25920. Therefore the binary complement with its full F2-linear stabilizer is not permutation-isomorphic to that W33 point action.
E8_consequence: The new 40=(7x7)-(3x3) object does not supply the missing identification between the 248-code and the certified E8 240->40 W33 root fibration through the natural PG(5,2) linear symmetry route.
boundary: This rejects the natural F2-linear/projective identification. It does not forbid defining an unrelated graph or nonlinear bijection on the same 40-element set.
